batch_gate_deferral_note: Per this dispatch's own Batch Gate Deferral section, the complete, whole-corpus gate set (bash agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/run-all.sh with no --only filter, 158 suites, ~540s+ hinted cost) is deferred to the once-per-invocation batch-level stage rather than independently run in full by this dispatch.
